messages:
sam: @here quick ping — PR #8450 (kv-evict-refactor) landed in canary last night and our multi-GPU long-seq throughput drooped ~18% on the 8xA100 cluster. bench artifacts: https://ci.redwood/artefacts/8450/bench-2026-06-10.html :eyes:

maria: ugh, thanks for the heads up. do we have the raw perf logs? numbers by seq len?

sam: added artifacts link above. short summary: p50 tokens/sec down 18%, p95 not much change, memory steady but allocator churn up. commands we ran:
```
bench/run.sh --config=multi-gpu-longseq --runs=6 --out=artifacts/8450
cat artifacts/8450/summary.csv | awk -F, '{print $1, $4,$5}'
```

ciara: pinging @zach and @maria for quick triage. timeline: we'd like to decide merge/rollback before the end of the day (we have a client demo tomorrow).

zach: looking now. can you paste the canary job ids? I want to diff kernel selection logs.

sam: canary job ids in the artifact index: job-6702, job-6703. i also uploaded the runtime profiler snapshots (low-frequency sampling).

bench-bot: Automated bench summary for PR#8450 -> multi-gpu-longseq:
 - baseline (master): p50=1200 tps, p95=900 tps
 - canary (PR): p50=980 tps, p95=880 tps
 - delta p50: -18.3% :warning:
Link: https://ci.redwood/artefacts/8450/summary.csv :robot_face:

maria: thanks. initial hypothesis: the refactor bumped shard metadata update frequency which may increase cross-device syncs. if that's true throughput drop with p95 stable makes sense. can we grep for more frequent flushes in runtime logs?

sam: grep shows more frequent "kv_shard_update" messages, timestamps closer together in canary. snippet:
```
[2026-06-10T02:12:33Z] kv_shard_update shard=12 dur=12ms
[2026-06-10T02:12:33Z] kv_shard_update shard=3 dur=11ms
[2026-06-10T02:12:33Z] kv_shard_update shard=7 dur=13ms
```
baseline had fewer per-second entries.

ciara: ok. two options: 1) revert the refactor (safe) 2) try a hotfix that batches shard updates (risky w/o bench). which do we prefer? Client demo pressure favors revert.

zach: i'd be +1 revert for demo. we can do a targeted microbench to validate batching before reapplying refactor. can someone create a quick microbench that simulates shard update frequency?

sam: on it — will run a microbench against staging kernels and post results in ~30m. if results look good we can consider a hotpatch instead of full revert.

maria: tagging @oncall-bot for rollback window approval and to get infra to hold new canaries for an hour. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Rollback window request received. Please confirm target deployment (canary -> stable) and preferred ETA. If approved, infra will schedule a rollback job within 15 minutes.

ciara: target = canary cluster 8xA100 (cluster-evict-2). preferred ETA = now -> as soon as infra confirms.

zach: quick ask for reviewers: if we revert, please ack the revert PR so infra can promote. i'll prepare the revert and mark for expedited merge.

sam: microbench results (15m): replicates the regression when shard_update frequency high. p50 falls ~17% on local sim. logs show extra cross-device waits in the scheduler.

maria: thanks. i'm +1 revert. ciara, you want me to approve the revert PR once it's up?

ciara: yes please. i'll post the revert PR in this thread when created. expecting in 10m.

bench-bot: Microbench artifact uploaded: https://ci.redwood/artefacts/8450/microbench.json - spike correlated to shard_update bursts.

zach: once revert is merged, let's run a controlled canary with the revert patch and the original refactor on a small fraction to ensure no other regressions. plan: revert -> promote -> run A/B internal canary between master and refactor.

sam: sounds good. thanks all for the quick eyes :heart:

maria: ping when revert PR URL is up. I'll do the expedited review.

ciara: revert PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8462 -- marking as urgent and adding reviewers: @maria @zach @sam :exclamation:

maria: LGTM, leaving a minor comment about test flakiness, approving now. :thumbsup:

zach: approved, merging after CI passes.

bench-bot: CI results: PR#8462 -> all checks passed. merge completed at 2026-06-10T03:02:40Z.

sam: thanks everyone. infra, please promote and schedule canary smoke. @oncall-bot can you confirm?

oncall-bot: Canary promote scheduled to start in 2 minutes on cluster-evict-2. Notifying infra.

maria: will watch the new canary artifacts, will report any anomalies. if p50 recovers we're clear for the demo.

ciara: closing loop — thanks for fast turn. we'll follow up with a postmortem if needed but tentatively treating as revert+followup. :relieved:

zach: quick note: let's add a microbench to CI that simulates shard_update-heavy workloads so this doesn't regress again. filing ticket now.

sam: filed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/1789 — microbench CI for shard update patterns.

maria: awesome. moving to watch channel.

ciara: :raised_hands:
